routes.description: THE regulated crossing — Terminal Aquaviário Público to the island's main pier. AGEPAR-tariffed public service, 30-min barca today, 383,162 boardings across the crossing system in 2025. Signature corridor of the market.
Second leg of the regulated crossing, to the southern village pier (Encantadas holds a 5,146-visitor share of the new daily cap). Same tariff table and credentialed fleet.

Inter-village island hop between the two piers — today an informal local boat transfer or a hilly 1.5-2h walking trail. Distance is haversine along the island's sheltered west shore (Mar de Dentro); negligible wrap.

Heritage-port bay corridor: Paranaguá's Rua da Praia waterfront to the island, 1h30 by lancha today (~R$80-90). Haversine 10.9 nm + ~1 nm coastal-wrap margin for the buoyed channel around Ilha da Cotinga. Signature corridor #2.
Paranaguá to the southern village — Abaline runs a 07:30 Paranaguá→Encantadas departure. Haversine 10.6 nm + channel-wrap margin.
Scheduled community boats Mon-Sat (R$40). Fishing-village island in the Superagui NP buffer; dolphin waters. Haversine 10.0 nm + ~1 nm bay-channel margin.

UNESCO Lagamar eco-corridor: one weekday boat today (14:00, R$60, ~3h via bay channels). Haversine 14.5 nm + ~2.5 nm wrap for the routed path through the channel between Ilha das Peças and Superagui — sea path winds, stated margin applied.

Ilha do Mel → Superagui excursion leg (Abaline lists Superagui departures from Ilha do Mel). Crosses the bay mouth (Canal da Galheta); haversine 6.0 nm + ~1 nm margin to skirt the shipping channel and shoals.

Daily nautical-taxi link (~50 min) to the isolated municipal seat of Guaraqueçaba — water is the practical access, the road is a poor dirt track. Haversine 16.5 nm + ~2.5 nm wrap for the winding northern-bay channels between islands.
Marina spur: Pontal do Paraná's deep-water marina/boatyard cluster direct to the island — premium charter departures and a natural charging node. Haversine, open sheltered water, no wrap needed.
